statuses.label: PROPOSED
statuses.definition: Research question or object has been registered but substantive work has not started.

statuses.label: IN PROGRESS
statuses.definition: Collection, analysis, coding or drafting is underway and no release claim is made.

statuses.label: RELEASE CANDIDATE
statuses.definition: A frozen candidate exists for final QA/review but is not yet a published final release.

statuses.label: PUBLISHED
statuses.definition: A citable public release has been issued with a stable version and publication record.

statuses.label: EXTERNALLY REVIEWED
statuses.definition: An outside reviewer has completed a documented review of the relevant object or method.

statuses.label: REPRODUCED
statuses.definition: An independent party has rerun the specified reproducible object and a result record exists.

statuses.label: ARCHIVED
statuses.definition: The object is no longer active but remains permanently addressable and citable.

rule: Statuses are additive only where evidence supports them. Externally reviewed or reproduced may not be inferred from institution-level aggregate counts without object-level mapping.
